findings.title: SQL injection (error-based) in 'id'
findings.description: Injecting into 'id' produced a database error, indicating unsanitised input reaches an SQL query.
findings.evidence: payload="'"; db-error marker='you have an error in your sql syntax'
findings.impact: Full read/modify access to the database; often leads to full system compromise.
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements; never concatenate user input into SQL.

findings.title: Sensitive file exposed: /.env
findings.description: The path /.env is publicly reachable and returned HTTP 200.
findings.impact: May disclose credentials, source code, or configuration that aids further attacks.
findings.remediation: Remove the file from the web root or block access via server config; rotate any leaked secrets.

findings.title: Reflected XSS in 'q'
findings.description: Input in 'q' is reflected into the HTML response without encoding.
findings.impact: An attacker can run arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser (session theft, defacement).
findings.remediation: Context-aware output encoding; validate input; add a Content-Security-Policy.

findings.remediation: Context-aware output encoding; validate input; add a Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: Sensitive file exposed: /robots.txt
findings.description: The path /robots.txt is publicly reachable and returned HTTP 200.
findings.impact: May disclose configuration or metadata useful to an attacker.
findings.remediation: Remove the file from the web root or block access via server config; rotate any leaked secrets.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: The response is missing the 'content-security-policy' header.
findings.evidence: Response headers: content-length, content-type, date, server, set-cookie
findings.impact: Without CSP, injected scripts run freely, worsening XSS impact.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
findings.description: The response is missing the 'strict-transport-security' header.
findings.evidence: Response headers: content-length, content-type, date, server, set-cookie
findings.impact: Users can be downgraded to HTTP and have traffic intercepted.

findings.title: Directory listing enabled: /uploads/
findings.description: The directory /uploads/ returns an auto-generated file index.
findings.impact: Attackers can browse and download files not meant to be listed (backups, source, uploads).
findings.remediation: Disable auto-indexing (e.g. 'Options -Indexes' on Apache; 'autoindex off' on nginx).

findings.title: POST form without anti-CSRF token
findings.description: A state-changing form has no hidden CSRF token field.
findings.impact: An attacker page can submit this form on behalf of a logged-in victim.
findings.remediation: Add a per-session/per-request CSRF token and verify it server-side; use SameSite cookies.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.description: The response is missing the 'x-frame-options' header.
findings.evidence: Response headers: content-length, content-type, date, server, set-cookie
findings.impact: The page can be framed, enabling clickjacking.
findings.remediation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: The response is missing the 'x-content-type-options' header.
findings.evidence: Response headers: content-length, content-type, date, server, set-cookie
findings.impact: Browsers may MIME-sniff responses, enabling some attacks.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.description: The response is missing the 'referrer-policy' header.
findings.evidence: Response headers: content-length, content-type, date, server, set-cookie
findings.impact: Full URLs may leak to third parties via the Referer header.

findings.title: Cookie 'SESSIONID' missing flags: HttpOnly, SameSite
findings.impact: Session cookies may be stolen via XSS or sent over plaintext / cross-site requests.
findings.remediation: Set HttpOnly, Secure (on HTTPS), and an explicit SameSite attribute on session cookies.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.description: The response is missing the 'permissions-policy' header.
findings.evidence: Response headers: content-length, content-type, date, server, set-cookie
findings.impact: Powerful browser features are not explicitly restricted.
findings.remediation: Add a Permissions-Policy header disabling unused features.

findings.title: Software version disclosed in 'Server' header
findings.description: The 'Server' header reveals a version: BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.11.9, VulnServer/1.2.3.
findings.impact: Version info helps attackers match known CVEs.
